title: Invertibility of restricted derived-Hom evaluation
statement: The explicitly constructed additive morphism $c_{h,p,F,U}$ of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map] is an isomorphism for every scheme morphism $h$, etale object $U$, abelian etale sheaf $F$ and degree $p\geq0$, without an affine, nonempty or qcqs hypothesis.

proof.text: Unfolding the explicitly constructed comparison map shows it is the composite of the evaluation morphism with RawRestrictedComparison.shiftIso.hom. The evaluation factor is an isomorphism by lem-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-evaluation-is-iso.
RawRestrictedComparison.shiftIso is an isomorphism by construction, so the composite is an isomorphism.
